title: Clamping Numeric Precision without Boundary Checks
pattern: Silently clamping or coercing invalid input values to their closest legal bounds instead of raising an error.
why_bad: It destroys data validity context. Downstream systems receive modified data without knowing that the caller passed completely invalid inputs, masking software bugs or sensor malfunctions.
detection: Conditional branches in input-processing logic that reassign out-of-bounds inputs to boundary constants without reporting.
counterexample:
Explicit clamping operations where the transition is documented and expected by design:
```rust
fn clamp_pixel_brightness(val: u8) -> u8 { val.clamp(0, 255) }
```
